news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹36.21 (down from ₹39.33 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹16.6b (up 33% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹947.7m (down 1.6% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 5.7% (down from 7.7% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.4%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 2.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 11% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 23% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.body: Analysts have kept Ethos's fair value estimate steady at ₹3,200, with only small tweaks to the discount rate, long term revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E assumptions. This reflects largely unchanged conviction in the stock's fundamental outlook.

news.title: ETHOSLTD: Stable Assumptions And Upcoming Meetings Will Support Constructive Future P E Repricing
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value target for Ethos broadly unchanged at ₹3,200, with only slight tweaks to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E inputs. This reflects fine tuning of their assumptions rather than a shift in their overall view.

news.title: ETHOSLTD: Modestly Lower Risk Assumptions Will Support Constructive Future P E Repricing
news.body: Analysts have left their fair value estimate for Ethos unchanged at ₹3,200. However, a slightly lower discount rate and a marginally reduced assumed future P/E multiple are leading them to frame this price target as being supported more by modestly adjusted risk and valuation assumptions than by any shift in growth or margin expectations.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 21%, revenue upgraded
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2026 has been updated. 2026 revenue forecast increased from ₹15.6b to ₹15.9b. EPS estimate fell from ₹48.20 to ₹37.95 per share. Net income forecast to grow 34% next year vs 34% growth forecast for Specialty Retail industry in India. Consensus price target down from ₹3,500 to ₹3,200. Share price fell 5.8% to ₹2,477 over the past week.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹11.46. Revenue: ₹4.84b (up 31% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹304.3m (up 3.2% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.3% (down from 8.0% in 3Q 2025).
